<h2 class="w3-center">Create and share floor plans quickly and easily.</h2>
<div class="w3-row-padding w3-center" style="margin-top:64px">
<div class="w3-third">
<i class="fa fa-rocket w3-margin-bottom w3-jumbo w3-center w3-text-aqua"></i>
<p class="w3-large">Fast &amp; precise</p>
<p>Move rooms and symbols with mouse or set their sizes and distances numerically when high precision is required.</p>
</div>
<div class="w3-third">
<a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.planmieszkania.android" target="_blank"><i class="fa fa-android w3-margin-bottom w3-jumbo w3-text-light-green w3-hover-opacity"></i></a>
<i class="fa fa-laptop w3-margin-bottom w3-jumbo w3-text-light-grey"></i>
<i class="fa fa-desktop w3-margin-bottom w3-jumbo"></i>
<p class="w3-large">Multi-platform</p>
<p>Use your mobile device on location and complete the work on your computer at the office.</p>
</div>
<div class="w3-third">
<i class="fa fa-cube w3-margin-bottom w3-jumbo w3-text-cyan"></i>
<p class="w3-large">3D mode</p>
<p>See your project in 3D, as many floors as you need. Camera can be freely positioned.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="w3-center w3-margin-top">
<a class="w3-hover-pale-green w3-margin w3-btn w3-green w3-large" href="/plan/demo">Create a project</a>
		or
		<a class="w3-hover-opacity" href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.planmieszkania.android" target="_blank"><img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 200px"/></a>

<div class="w3-container w3-khaki" style="padding:128px 16px">
<h3 class="w3-center">FEATURES</h3>
<p class="w3-large w3-margin w3-center">Create detailed and precise floor plans. See them in 3D or print to scale. Add furniture to design interior of your home. Have your floor plan with you while shopping to check if there is enough room for a new furniture.</p>
<div class="w3-container w3-padding-48">
<ul style="display:table; margin:0 auto;">
<li>Native Android version and HTML5 version available that runs on any computer or mobile device.</li>
<li>Projects can have multiple floors with rooms of any shape (straight walls only).</li>
<li>Import existing plan and use it as a template.</li>
<li>Automatic calculation of room, walls and level area; perimeter; counts of symbols.</li>
<li>Symbol library: doors, windows, furniture, electrical, fire survey.</li>
<li>User symbol library, where you can store rooms, symbols (also grouped) and labels for quick reuse.</li>
<li>User defined dimension lines to show and modify distances and sizes.</li>
<li>Cloud synchronization to automatically backup and share plans between devices.</li>
<li>Export plan as image, PDF (print to scale), DXF, SVG.</li>
<li>Generate Wavefront .obj files, which can be imported into most 3D rendering programs and game engines.</li>
<li>Supports metric and imperial units.</li>
<li>Android version supports Bosch (GLM 50c, 100c; PLR 30c, 40c, 50c), Hersch LEM 50, Hilti PD-I, Leica Disto, Mileseey, Stabila (LD 520, LD 250 BT), Suaoki and CEM iLDM-150 bluetooth laser meters.</li>
<li><a href="/changelog">Changelog</a>.
	</li></ul>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="w3-modal" id="purchaseDialog">

</header>
<div class="w3-container">
<p id="status"><i class="fa fa-spinner fa-pulse fa-2x fa-fw"></i> Please wait... Your subscription should be activated shortly.</p>
<p>You can check the state of your subscription on <a class="w3-hover-text-green" href="/account">Your Account</a> page.</p>

<script>
function setVariant(show, plans) {
	var freq = document.getElementsByClassName('freq');
	for (var i=0; i<freq.length; i++) freq[i].innerText = show;
	var year = document.getElementsByClassName('year');
	for (var i=0; i<year.length; i++) year[i].style.display = show == 'year' ? '' : 'none';
	var month = document.getElementsByClassName('month');
	for (var i=0; i<month.length; i++) month[i].style.display = show == 'month' ? '' : 'none';
	return false;
}

function onPurchase(data) {
	document.getElementById("purchaseDialog").style.display='block';
	Paddle.Order.details(data.checkout.id, function(data) {
		if (data.state == 'processed') {
			setTimeout(function(){
				window.location.assign("/account/?msg=4");
			}, 2000);
		} else {
			document.getElementById("status").innerHTML = "There was a problem processing your purchase. Please contact me at <a href=\"mailto:support@floorplancreator.net\">support@floorplancreator.net</a>";
		}
	});
}

function change(plan) {
	document.getElementById("bill").style.display = plan == 'pro-yearly' ? '' : 'none';
	document.getElementById("changeLink").href = "/account/change?plan=" + plan;
	document.getElementById("newplan").innerHTML = plan == "standard" ? "Standard" : (plan == "pro-yearly" ? "Pro - yearly" : "Pro - monthly");
	document.getElementById("changeDialog").style.display = 'block';
}

setTimeout(function () {
	var resume = document.getElementById('resume');
	if (resume) resume.click();
}, 2000);
</script>
